notes.title: Get achievements at the touch of a key!
notes.content: Now you can get all the achievements by pressing the "A" key in the main menu of the game.

notes.title: Changed the algorithm for mixing tiles
notes.content:
1. Previously, there was a problem with mixing tiles at the very beginning of the level, since they were often mixed in such a way that it was impossible to collect a full picture (to put each tile in its place). This issue has now been fixed. But still, sometimes there may be rare cases when the puzzle will not work.

2. The game has been moved to a more recent version of the game engine.
